column7: Decides whether a protected-resource document names the configured resource (its spelling or serialized URL), the RFC 9728 s3.3 audience check every candidate is held to (MIK-8320)
Walks hint, path-inserted and origin candidates and refuses a document naming another resource, so no authorization server, scope or token audience is taken from it (MIK-8320, MIK-8324)
Refuses a candidate URL the destination policy denies (IP literals included) before fetching it; only a non-document or transport failure moves on (MIK-8320)
Reads the 401 resource_metadata hint through the redirect-free client, so a 3xx names nothing and its Location is never fetched (MIK-8324)
Builds the RFC 9728 path-inserted well-known URL; a wrong URL is still held to the configured resource by names (MIK-8320)
